features.feature: Full-bootstrap Vercel pkg packaging command builds Koala packages and emits a host desktop executable under dist/desktop.
Packaging uses the complete bin/koala.js bootstrap and includes runtime assets/templates/metadata so aux_* commands do not regress to a core-only CLI.
Generated binary is smoke-tested directly, including missing-artifact recovery and bootstrap/module-loading failure detection.
Release maintainer documentation covers host packaging, host smoke, multi-platform release targets, output paths, desktop carry instructions, and pkg deprecation caveat.
Installer, code signing, notarization, and full desktop release automation.
features.excluded_by: background.md:方案取舍 explicitly limits this story to an early pkg deployment path rather than a full installer/signing pipeline.
